annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Consolidation of CLI tools changed the device-code OAuth client_id to `cli-${referrer}`; CTS only registers `cli`, so login with a referrer fails INVALID_CLIENT.

known_defects.description: Device code flow sends client id `cli-<referrer>`; only `cli` is registered; login fails with INVALID_CLIENT
known_defects.mechanism: login(region, referrer) builds client id from referrer
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the OAuth/device-flow client identifier now varies (by referrer) and may be rejected by the auth server.

known_defects.description: stash bin is built with skipNodeModulesBundle while @cipherstash/stack is only a devDependency, so the published CLI cannot resolve it at runtime
known_defects.fixed_by: commit aa06dd126 (fix: cli runtime, adds an optional peer dependency)
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the published CLI imports @cipherstash/stack at runtime without declaring it as a runtime or peer dependency.
known_defects.added_reason: Found in an evaluator's finding during dev-split adjudication and confirmed by a later fix in the repository. Excluded from the pre-registered metrics; reported separately.

known_defects.description: security overrides moved to a top-level npm-format `overrides` block, which pnpm ignores, so forced transitive versions stop applying
known_defects.fixed_by: commit d2322980e (deletes the inert overrides block)
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the moved overrides are not read by pnpm and the pinned versions no longer apply.
known_defects.added_reason: Found in an evaluator's finding during dev-split adjudication and confirmed by a later fix in the repository. Excluded from the pre-registered metrics; reported separately.
